sections.heading: Melania Trump — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Melania Trump was born on 26 April 1970 in Novo Mesto, and holds citizenship of Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, Slovenia and United States. She was given the name Melanija Knavs at birth and is publicly known as Melania Trump.
Public records name her father, Viktor Knavs and her mother, Amalija Knavs. She is a sibling of Ines Knauss and Denis Cigelnjak.
Her listed education includes Secondary School for Design and Photography, Ljubljana.
She is recorded as speaking Slovene, Serbian, English and German.
